codes.name: InvalidAddress
codes.message: The server address is missing or not a valid URL or cluster name.
codes.hint: Set `Address` (or `BASTIONVAULT_ADDR`) to `https://host:8200`, or to a bare DNS name for cluster discovery. IPv6 literals must be bracketed.

codes.name: InsecureHttpNotAllowed
codes.message: Plain `http://` to a non-loopback host is not allowed.
codes.hint: Use `https://`, or set `AllowInsecureHttp = true` only for isolated test networks.

codes.name: InvalidSettingValue
codes.message: A configuration value has the wrong type or range.
codes.hint: Check `Details.setting`; booleans accept 1/0/true/false/yes/no/on/off, durations accept `30s`, `1m30s` or integer seconds; timeouts must be > 0.

codes.name: ClientCertIncomplete
codes.message: Only one of `ClientCertPath` / `ClientKeyPath` is set.
codes.hint: Provide both the client certificate and its private key (PEM), or neither.

codes.name: FileNotReadable
codes.message: A configured file cannot be read.
codes.hint: Check `Details.path` exists and the process user can read it.

codes.name: InvalidPem
codes.message: A certificate or key is not valid PEM.
codes.hint: Ensure the file contains `-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----`/`PRIVATE KEY` blocks and is not DER or PKCS#12.

codes.name: InvalidNamespace
codes.message: The namespace path is malformed.
codes.hint: Use `parent/child` without a leading slash, whitespace or control characters.

codes.name: ReservedHeader
codes.message: A custom header would override a header the SDK manages.
codes.hint: Remove `X-BastionVault-Token`, `X-Vault-Token`, `Authorization`, `Cookie`, `X-BastionVault-Namespace`, `Host`, `Content-Length` from `Headers`; use `Token`/`Namespace` instead.

codes.name: ListVerbUnsupported
codes.message: The HTTP stack cannot send the custom `LIST` method.
codes.hint: Use the SDK's default transport or an HTTP client that allows non-standard methods; the server does not support `?list=true`.

codes.name: EncryptedTokenFile
codes.message: The token file is in the CLI's encrypted `BVTOK1:` format.
codes.hint: Set `BASTIONVAULT_TOKEN`, or export a token with `bvault ferrogate token --field client_token`; the SDK reads plaintext token files only.

codes.name: TokenFileNotWritable
codes.message: The token file cannot be written.
codes.hint: Check `Details.path`'s directory exists and the process user can write it; `Auth.PersistToken` needs owner-only write access.

codes.name: InvalidArgument
codes.message: An argument is missing or invalid.
codes.hint: See `Details.argument` and `Details.reason`; required strings must be non-empty, `env` cannot contain `/`, `env` and `envs` are mutually exclusive.

codes.name: EmptyCollection
codes.message: A list argument must not be empty.
codes.hint: Provide at least one item (`paths`, `versions`, `operations`).

codes.name: BatchTooLarge
codes.message: The batch exceeds the maximum number of operations.
codes.hint: Split into batches of at most `Details.max` (default 128) operations.

codes.name: OutOfRange
codes.message: A numeric argument is out of range.
codes.hint: Respect the documented bounds: `limit` 1–500, `topics` ≤ 64, `Random.bytes` ≤ 4096.

codes.name: IterationCapExceeded
codes.message: A paging iterator stopped at its safety cap.
codes.hint: Raise `MaxRecords` or filter server-side; `Details.total` reports the full count.

codes.name: UnsupportedOption
codes.message: The option is not supported by BastionVault.
codes.hint: Response wrapping (`WrapTtl`) is not implemented by the server; remove the option.

codes.name: BodyTooLarge
codes.message: The request body exceeds the server limit.
codes.hint: Keep bodies under 32 MiB; for files, upload smaller versions or use sync targets.

codes.name: ChunkIndexOutOfRange
codes.message: The recording chunk index is past the end.
codes.hint: Read chunk 0 first and stop at `eof`; `Details.chunk_count` is the real count.

codes.name: ReservedTokenMetaKey
codes.message: A `meta` key is reserved by the server.
codes.hint: Remove `Details.keys` (identity/namespace/scope keys such as `username`, `spiffe_id`, `approle_env_*`); use application-specific key names.

codes.name: ReservedPolicyName
codes.message: The policy name is reserved.
codes.hint: `root`, `default` (delete) and `test` cannot be written or deleted; choose another name.

codes.name: InvalidCiphertextFormat
codes.message: The value is not a BastionVault ciphertext/signature.
codes.hint: Expected `bvault:v<N>:<base64>` (or `bvault:v<N>:pqc:<algo>:<base64>`); pass the exact string returned by Transit.

codes.name: NotBase64
codes.message: A binary field was not valid base64.
codes.hint: Pass raw bytes and let the SDK encode, or use the `*Base64` parameter with valid standard base64.

codes.name: ServerRejectedRequest
codes.message: The server rejected the request as invalid.
codes.hint: Read `ServerMessage`; typical causes are a missing required field, a wrong field type, or a mutually exclusive combination.

codes.name: InvalidUnsealKey
codes.message: The unseal key was rejected.
codes.hint: Provide a valid hex key share from `Sys.Init`; check for copy/paste truncation.

codes.name: CrossNamespacePolicyPath
codes.message: The policy references a path outside its namespace.
codes.hint: Policies are namespace-scoped; remove `sys/*`/`auth/*` or other-tenant paths, or write the policy in the namespace that owns them.

codes.name: BackupFileInvalid
codes.message: The backup file failed integrity checks.
codes.hint: The `.bvbk` file is corrupted, tampered, or from an unsupported version; restore from a fresh `Sys.Backup`.

codes.name: ConnectionFailed
codes.message: Could not connect to the server.
codes.hint: Check `Address`, DNS, firewall and that the server is listening (default `https://127.0.0.1:8200`).

codes.name: Timeout
codes.message: The request timed out.
codes.hint: Increase `Timeout`/`ConnectTimeout`, check server load; long-poll calls need ≥ 40 s.

codes.name: TlsError
codes.message: TLS handshake or certificate verification failed.
codes.hint: Provide the server CA via `CaCertPath`; check `TlsServerName` matches a SAN; verify the clock. Only as a diagnostic step, and never in production, `TlsSkipVerify` confirms whether trust is the cause.

codes.name: ResponseTooLarge
codes.message: The response exceeded `MaxResponseBytes`.
codes.hint: Use the chunked route (`Rustion.Recordings.Download`) or paging (`*-info`), or raise `MaxResponseBytes`.

codes.name: Cancelled
codes.message: The operation was cancelled.
codes.hint: The caller cancelled; no request state is known. Retry is the caller's decision.

codes.name: MethodNotAllowed
codes.message: The server does not accept this HTTP method on this path.
codes.hint: Only GET, POST/PUT, DELETE and LIST are routed; use the matching logical operation.

codes.name: UnexpectedResponse
codes.message: The server response could not be interpreted.
codes.hint: The body was not JSON or not a known shape (`Details.snippet`); confirm `Address` points at a BastionVault API listener, not a proxy or GUI.

codes.name: UnexpectedRedirect
codes.message: The server answered with a redirect.
codes.hint: BastionVault never redirects; a proxy or load balancer in front of it does. Point `Address` at the vault or fix the proxy.

codes.name: DigestMismatch
codes.message: Downloaded bytes do not match the expected SHA-256.
codes.hint: The artifact was corrupted in transit or on the server; do not use it. Retry once, then inspect the server/bastion.

codes.name: NoToken
codes.message: No token is configured for an authenticated request.
codes.hint: Set `Token`/`BASTIONVAULT_TOKEN`, or configure a `Login` token source (AppID, Userpass, FerroGate).

codes.name: Unauthenticated
codes.message: The server requires authentication for this call.
codes.hint: Provide a valid token; for connect-MFA calls the caller must be a userpass principal.

codes.name: LoginRejected
codes.message: The login was rejected.
codes.hint: The server answered 200 without a token: `ServerMessage` gives the reason; check credentials and account state.

codes.name: InvalidCredentials
codes.message: Invalid username or password.
codes.hint: Verify the username, the password, and that the user exists on this mount (`Details.mount`).

codes.name: AccountDisabled
codes.message: The account is disabled.
codes.hint: An administrator must set `disabled = false` on `auth/<mount>/users/<name>`.

codes.name: AccountLocked
codes.message: The account is temporarily locked after failed attempts.
codes.hint: Wait `Details.retry_after_secs` seconds or ask an administrator to call `Unlock`; do not retry automatically.

codes.name: TotpRequired
codes.message: A TOTP code is required for this account.
codes.hint: Pass `totpCode` to `Userpass.Login`.

codes.name: InvalidTotp
codes.message: The TOTP code is invalid.
codes.hint: Check clock skew and the code's 30 s window; failed codes count toward lockout.

codes.name: PasswordLoginDisabled
codes.message: Password login is disabled for this account.
codes.hint: Use the FIDO2 login flow (`Userpass.Fido2LoginBegin/Complete`).

codes.name: InvalidAppIdCredentials
codes.message: The AppID role_id or secret_id is invalid or exhausted.
codes.hint: Check `role_id`, generate a fresh `secret_id` (it may be single-use or expired), and confirm the mount path.

codes.name: AppIdMachineBinding
codes.message: The AppID login failed the machine-identity check.
codes.hint: Pass a FerroGate `machine_token` for a machine bound to the role, or have an admin set `bypass_machine_binding = true` on the role (paired with `bound_source_ips`).

codes.name: EnrolmentPending
codes.message: The machine is awaiting administrator approval.
codes.hint: An admin must approve the machine (`Auth.Ferrogate.Admin.Approve`); poll `Auth.Ferrogate.Status`.

codes.name: EnrolmentRejected
codes.message: The machine enrolment was rejected.
codes.hint: Contact the vault administrator; the machine must be re-registered.

codes.name: MachineRevoked
codes.message: The machine's access was revoked.
codes.hint: Contact the vault administrator.

codes.name: TokenNotRenewable
codes.message: The token cannot be renewed.
codes.hint: The token is expired, revoked, non-renewable (batch) or past `explicit_max_ttl`; log in again.

codes.name: SecondFactorFailed
codes.message: Second-factor verification failed.
codes.hint: Check the TOTP code or FIDO2 assertion and retry the MFA flow.

codes.name: TokenSourceFailed
codes.message: The configured token source did not produce a token.
codes.hint: The source itself failed, and its exception is the cause; a `Callback` source must return a token or handle its own failure.

codes.name: PermissionDenied
codes.message: The token does not have permission for this path (or the token is invalid, expired or revoked).
codes.hint: Check the token's policies grant the capability on `Details.path` (`Sys.CapabilitiesSelf`); verify the token with `Auth.Token.LookupSelf`; if the credential is namespace-scoped set `Namespace`; a `token_bound_cidrs` or `bound_source_ips` rule may exclude this client.

codes.name: NamespaceNotOperable
codes.message: The token cannot operate in the active namespace.
codes.hint: The token is bound to `Details.token_namespace` and is not child-visible for `Details.active_namespace`; log in with the namespace header or use a child-visible token.

codes.name: ClusterStatusGated
codes.message: Cluster status requires a token or a cluster-local caller.
codes.hint: Provide any valid token, or run from a cluster node.

codes.name: PrincipalNotAllowed
codes.message: A requested SSH principal is not allowed by the role.
codes.hint: Use principals listed in the role's `allowed_users`, or update the role.

codes.name: LoginClassLocked
codes.message: The SSH login class is locked by an upstream policy tier.
codes.hint: Change it at the tier that holds the lock (global/type/asset-group) or remove the lock.

codes.name: PathNotFound
codes.message: Nothing exists at this path.
codes.hint: Check the mount and the engine's path layout (`Details.path`); KV v2 data lives under `<mount>/data/<name>`; unregistered `sys/*` routes also answer 404.

codes.name: MountNotFound
codes.message: No secrets engine or auth method is mounted at this path.
codes.hint: List mounts with `Sys.ListMounts`/`Sys.ListAuthMethods`; check the namespace.

codes.name: PolicyNotFound
codes.message: No policy with this name exists.
codes.hint: `Sys.ListPolicies` shows available names; names are namespace-scoped.

codes.name: TokenNotFound
codes.message: The token does not exist or was revoked.
codes.hint: Log in again; a revoked or expired token cannot be looked up or renewed.

codes.name: NamespaceNotFound
codes.message: No such namespace.
codes.hint: `Sys.ListNamespaces` from the parent namespace; paths are relative to the active namespace.

codes.name: ResourceNotFound
codes.message: The named object does not exist in this engine.
codes.hint: Check the name and mount; `Details.kind` names the object type (target, role, key…).

codes.name: Conflict
codes.message: The request conflicts with current server state.
codes.hint: Read `ServerMessage`; re-read the object and retry with the current state.

codes.name: RecordingDigestMismatch
codes.message: The recording bytes do not match the recorded digest.
codes.hint: Deterministic failure: do not retry; inspect the bastion and the sidecar digest.

codes.name: BrokeredResourceStaticCredential
codes.message: A static SSH credential cannot be attached to a brokered resource.
codes.hint: Remove `private_key`/`password` or change the resource's `login_class`.

codes.name: MountPathInUse
codes.message: The destination mount path is already in use.
codes.hint: Choose another `to` path or unmount the existing engine first.

codes.name: AlreadyInitialized
codes.message: The vault is already initialized.
codes.hint: Use `Sys.Unseal` with existing key shares; `Init` only runs once.

codes.name: SecretAlreadyExists
codes.message: The secret already exists (CAS 0 failed).
codes.hint: Use `WriteSecret` with the current version as `cas`, or `UpdateWithRetry`.

codes.name: KeyNameExists
codes.message: A key with this name already exists.
codes.hint: Choose a different `name` or reference the existing key by `key_ref`.

codes.name: RateLimitedByDosGuard
codes.message: The server's abuse guard temporarily blocked this client IP.
codes.hint: The rate gate is paused for `RetryAfter` seconds. Reduce request fan-out — use `Sys.Batch`, `Kv.ReadMany`, `*-info` pages and a read cache — and do not add retries.

codes.name: NamespaceRateQuotaExceeded
codes.message: The namespace request-rate quota was exceeded.
codes.hint: Slow down or ask an admin to raise `request_rate` on the namespace; back off before retrying.

codes.name: NamespaceQuotaExceeded
codes.message: A namespace capacity quota was reached.
codes.hint: `ServerMessage` names the quota (mounts, leases, entities, storage); free capacity or raise the quota via `Sys.UpdateNamespace`.

codes.name: QueueFull
codes.message: The server queue is full.
codes.hint: Approve, reject or delete pending items before submitting more (limit in `Details.max`).

codes.name: Sealed
codes.message: The vault is sealed.
codes.hint: An operator must unseal it (`bvault operator unseal` or HSM auto-unseal); the SDK does not retry. Use `Sys.Health` to watch for readiness.

codes.name: Unavailable
codes.message: The server is temporarily unavailable.
codes.hint: Cluster has no leader/quorum, node unhealthy, or HSM unreachable; the SDK retries idempotent calls. Check `Sys.ClusterStatus` and node health.

codes.name: Standby
codes.message: The node is a standby and cannot serve this request.
codes.hint: Discovery should have picked the leader; call `Client.Reconnect()` or point `Address` at the leader.

codes.name: UnsupportedByServer
codes.message: This server version does not support the endpoint.
codes.hint: Check `Client.ServerVersion()`; upgrade the server or use the documented fallback (per-object reads instead of `*-info`, `/blob` instead of chunks). Also returned for disabled backends such as `cert` auth.

codes.name: InternalError
codes.message: The server reported an internal error.
codes.hint: Read `ServerMessage`; many engine validation errors are reported as 500 — the message names the field or object. Check server logs if it is generic.

codes.name: ApiVersionMismatch
codes.message: The engine is not available on the requested API version.
codes.hint: Pin the call to `/v2` (`RequestOptions.ApiVersion = 2`) or use the typed operation, which pins automatically.

codes.name: NotInitialized
codes.message: The vault is not initialized.
codes.hint: Run `Sys.Init` once and store the keys and root token securely.

codes.name: NoCandidates
codes.message: Cluster discovery found no nodes.
codes.hint: Check the SRV record `_bvault._tcp.<name>` exists, or use a literal `https://host:port` address.

codes.name: NoHealthyNode
codes.message: No healthy node was found in the cluster.
codes.hint: `Details.candidates` lists each node's state (sealed/uninitialized/unreachable); unseal or start the nodes, check TLS SANs cover SRV targets.

codes.name: NodeUnavailable
codes.message: The pinned node became unavailable.
codes.hint: Read/list calls fail over once automatically; for writes or node-local sessions call `Client.Reconnect()` and retry.

codes.name: StrictDiscoveryRefused
codes.message: Cluster discovery found no SRV records and strict discovery is enabled.
codes.hint: Publish the SRV record for the cluster name, or set `Discovery.StrictDiscovery = false` to accept a single literal candidate instead (this also disables failover, since it produces exactly one candidate).

codes.name: SecretNotFound
codes.message: No secret exists at this path.
codes.hint: Check mount and path (`<mount>/data/<name>` for v2); list with `Kv.V2.List`.

codes.name: DataFieldMissing
codes.message: The write has no data.
codes.hint: Provide a non-empty `data` map (v2 wraps it as `{"data": {...}}`).

codes.name: CasMismatch
codes.message: The check-and-set version did not match the current version.
codes.hint: Re-read the secret to get the current version and retry with `cas` set to it (or use `UpdateWithRetry`); `cas = 0` means the secret must not exist yet.

codes.name: CasRequired
codes.message: This secret or mount requires check-and-set.
codes.hint: Pass `WriteOptions.Cas` with the current version (0 for a new secret).

codes.name: VersionDestroyed
codes.message: The requested version was permanently destroyed.
codes.hint: Destroyed versions cannot be recovered; read another version or the latest.

codes.name: EnvironmentNotDeclared
codes.message: The secret has no overrides for this environment.
codes.hint: `Metadata.AvailableEnvs` lists declared environments; write overrides with `PatchEnvironment` or read the base.

codes.name: VersionSoftDeleted
codes.message: The requested version is soft-deleted.
codes.hint: Call `Kv.V2.Undelete` to restore it, or read another version.

codes.name: VersionNotFound
codes.message: The requested version does not exist.
codes.hint: Check `Kv.V2.ReadMetadata` for available versions; pruning by `max_versions` removes old ones.

codes.name: EnvironmentRequired
codes.message: This token is environment-scoped and must pass `env`.
codes.hint: Pass `env` matching the token's scope globs (`Details.secret_globs`, `Details.machine_globs`).

codes.name: NotAKvMount
codes.message: The mount is not a KV engine.
codes.hint: `Sys.MountTypeOf` reports `Details.type`; use the matching engine client.

codes.name: FieldNotFound
codes.message: The secret has no such field.
codes.hint: Available fields are `Details.fields`.

codes.name: KeyNotFound
codes.message: The transit key does not exist.
codes.hint: Create it with `Transit.CreateKey` or check the mount.

codes.name: KeyTypeConflict
codes.message: A key with this name exists with a different type.
codes.hint: Use another name, or delete the existing key (requires `deletion_allowed`).

codes.name: DeletionNotAllowed
codes.message: The key is protected from deletion.
codes.hint: Set `deletion_allowed = true` via `Transit.ConfigureKey` first.

codes.name: VersionNotDecryptable
codes.message: The ciphertext version is below `min_decryption_version` or missing.
codes.hint: Rewrap ciphertexts before raising `min_decryption_version`, or lower it via `Transit.ConfigureKey`.

codes.name: OperationNotSupportedByKeyType
codes.message: The key type does not support this operation.
codes.hint: Symmetric AEAD keys encrypt/decrypt; signature keys sign/verify; KEM keys use datakey.

codes.name: AlgorithmMismatch
codes.message: The ciphertext/signature algorithm does not match the key.
codes.hint: Use the key that produced the value; check the `pqc:<algo>` tag.

codes.name: RoleNotFound
codes.message: The PKI role does not exist.
codes.hint: Create it with `Pki.WriteRole`.

codes.name: CertificateNotFound
codes.message: No certificate with this serial.
codes.hint: Check the serial format (`aa:bb:…` or hex) and the mount.

codes.name: CaNotConfigured
codes.message: The mount has no CA.
codes.hint: Run `Pki.GenerateRoot` or `Pki.ConfigureCa` first.

codes.name: InvalidCaMaterial
codes.message: The CA bundle or chain is invalid.
codes.hint: Ensure the PEM contains a CA certificate matching its private key and a correct chain order.

codes.name: CaNotConfigured
codes.message: The SSH CA is not configured.
codes.hint: Call `Ssh.ConfigureCa` first.

codes.name: RoleNotFound
codes.message: The SSH role does not exist.
codes.hint: Create it with `Ssh.WriteRole`.

codes.name: IpNotAllowed
codes.message: The IP is outside the role's CIDR list.
codes.hint: Use an IP within `cidr_list` (not in `exclude_cidr_list`) or update the role.

codes.name: InvalidOtp
codes.message: The OTP is invalid or expired.
codes.hint: OTPs are single-use; request a new one with `Ssh.Creds`.

codes.name: WrongRoleMode
codes.message: The role's key_type does not match the operation.
codes.hint: Use `Ssh.Sign` for `ca` roles and `Ssh.Creds` for `otp` roles.

codes.name: PqcOnlyClassicalCa
codes.message: The role requires PQC but the CA is classical.
codes.hint: Reconfigure the CA with `algorithm = mldsa65` or clear `pqc_only`.

codes.name: KeyNotFound
codes.message: The TOTP key does not exist.
codes.hint: Create it with `Totp.CreateKey`.

codes.name: WrongModeForOperation
codes.message: The operation does not match the key mode.
codes.hint: Generate-mode keys: `GenerateCode`; provider-mode keys: `ValidateCode`.

codes.name: AuthorityPendingApproval
codes.message: The bastion has not approved this authority yet.
codes.hint: Approve the authority on the bastion side.

codes.name: AuthorityTombstoned
codes.message: The authority was tombstoned.
codes.hint: Rotate the master key and re-enrol.

codes.name: AttestationMismatch
codes.message: The authority attestation does not match.
codes.hint: Re-run `Rustion.Authority.Attest`.

codes.name: UnknownAuthority
codes.message: The bastion does not know this authority.
codes.hint: Export `Rustion.Master.PubKey` and enrol it on the bastion.

codes.name: SignatureInvalid
codes.message: The envelope signature failed verification.
codes.hint: Check the master key material; rotate if compromised.

codes.name: EnvelopeReplay
codes.message: The envelope was replayed.
codes.hint: Do not resend the same envelope; generate a new request.

codes.name: PolicyDenied
codes.message: The bastion policy denied the session.
codes.hint: Check `Rustion.Policy.Effective` for the resource.
